scope: Historical registration attachment browsing for the owner and administrator. Local behavior and actual Vue page verification only; prior customer-cloud registration acceptance remains a separate dated artifact.

checks: single project defaults correctly; missing leader, invalid phone, missing material and failed upload show visible feedback at 320px without submitting; successful retry dismisses the obsolete alert and toast
320px and 390px form sections, files and buttons have no horizontal overflow and text is at least 14px
cancel confirmation writes nothing; submission failure stays visible and blocks duplicate submissions until explicit reload; retry reaches pending review
approval uses the current event player range and requires material confirmation; each missing or invalid field shows nearby visible feedback at 320px without writing a review
registration submitted under 5–18 is approved for 2 players after the event changes to 2–18; original submission and approval ranges are both retained and the leader can read the result
a detail left open during another settings change reloads current rules before validation; 2 players is rejected after tightening to 4–18, with no review write
admin can edit event configuration, reject with reason and release a place; leader sees rejection
uncertain review failures block repeats; committed lost receipts recover detail, inbox status and counters together without another review
resubmission returns to review; verified player count and approval feed the final participant list
editing approved information clears approval; cancellation requires confirmation and releases capacity

actual replace-and-resubmit creates a private historical file; leader and admin list 22 files over bounded pages, retry reads, sign old downloads and render at desktop/390/320 without inferring old submission dates
history paging detects a registration version change, hides stale private files and requires an explicit registration reload
my registrations restores private records and deadline locks self-service actions
read failures hide stale records and recover through explicit retry
authenticated maintenance previews without deletion, removes expired temporary files, and retains submitted material at desktop/390/320 widths
browser.fileChooserAndWechatTransport: Isolated test adapters, not physical-device or customer-cloud evidence.
browser.adminHistoricalLinkPopup: Authorized test-only destination fulfilled by a browser route; not a cloud file download.
browser.wechatOpen: Owner-authorized link requested; H5 correctly reports that native opening requires WeChat.
